description: The flows this week's work touched, on a fresh scratch database: first-run sign-up with the ZIP and RDO pickers, a tax year with 2551Q, every screen, 2551Q money boxes (a zero box, a filled one, Item 16 with Amended Yes and No), Queue in the dry-run test build, a schedule row deleted, the birth date, Log out. Variants per target where a platform needs its own steps (the Linux window shows the narrow layout). Run with `just e2e <target> smoke --allow-send` under EBIR_TEST_ENV=1 BIR_SFTP_DRY_RUN=1; see docs/proof/E2E.md.

recipes.name: money-boxes
recipes.needs_host: an app built with nsh-gpui-agent at hexuria/nsh-gpui-agent#11 (the software keyboard in the tree)

known_gap.phone: gap 3: injected paced digits still land as permutations in the money box on iOS even after #403 and even clicking the box first (500.25 read back as .52500 / .52005 / 520.05, gpui-agent-cli 0.4.1); a person's keyed input needs the software keyboard host feature (nsh-gpui-agent#11), which this build does not have
gap 1: the row drawer is a sheet on a phone
known_gap.linux: gap 1: in the narrow layout of the Linux window, presses inside a sheet are refused as offscreen too (linux-final birth-date s14)

recipes.name: queue
recipes.precondition: Queue validates first. The recipe records the profile's business start date and income-tax election through the form's own banners, and the money-box recipe leaves Items 15 and 16 at zero, so the return validates; a return that does not stops at its to-do list instead of the confirm dialog

known_gap.phone: gap 1: the date is set in a date sheet
known_gap.linux: gap 1: in the narrow layout of the Linux window, presses inside a sheet are refused as offscreen too (linux-final birth-date s14)

known_gap.phone: gap 1: a sheet an earlier recipe left open (birth-date's Done press is refused) occludes the account menu; and under BIR_AUTH_BYPASS=1 no lock screen follows Log out (the macOS run of e2e-fixes-apple)
known_gap.linux: gap 1 in the Linux window's narrow layout: the date sheet birth-date left open (its Done press is refused offscreen) occludes the account menu
known_gap.windows: Log out is refused on a fresh database: endSession requires an admin PIN (or TOTP) for an admin session, and the suite safety rules forbid typing into a PIN box, so no run of this suite can sign out
known_gap.macos: under the mandatory BIR_AUTH_BYPASS=1 there is no lock gate: Log out is pressed (nb-menu-logout) but no locked-screen ever appears, so the wait can never pass in this environment
